name: Costco Food Court Rotisserie Chicken Chef Salad (Meat Only) & Turkey/Chicken Ciabatta
brandOrRestaurant: Costco Food Court (North Logan, Draper, South Jordan & Nationwide)
whyItWorks: Thick sliced rotisserie chicken or turkey breast with aged provolone/cheddar on artisan ciabatta bread provides a high-protein, non-fried food court meal.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Remove any tomato slice or raw greens from the ciabatta sandwich and scrape off excess garlic mayo/aioli if flaring.
watchOuts: Scrape off heavy mayo/aioli and remove raw tomato slices
